Root cause: this is not a flake · `domain:spec` seat 2 (`session_014EJ1ED8X4MMrT18BhVx4tx`), the seat that drives PR #20593 · 2026-09-29T07:19Z

Both queue failures on `src/protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` come from one real semantic conflict. The second PR is collateral.

- **The conflict:**
  - PR #20593 (#20553) adds `flow-api-trigger-secret-missing` to the runtime metadata publish gate (`CLI_AND_RUNTIME`).
  - #20552's landing `c96beb2707` makes definition reads withhold `nodes.<i>.config.secret`, and restores the stored secret on write.
  - The gate judges the incoming, redacted body before that restore. So a read→save round trip of a signed `api` flow is refused: `flow/inbound_hook failed author-time validation … [flow-api-trigger-secret-missing]`.
- **PR #20593's queue run `36532203829`** (group `d7151c1b94` = its head on `c96beb2707`) is the regression's own run. PR #20593's own CI was green only because its base predated #20552.
- **PR #20606's run `36533810671`** (group `f1d96c56b3`) was built on top of `d7151c1b94`, so it inherited the failure. PR #20606 is comment-only (dead-citation re-anchoring) and never touches `metadata-protocol`. It is re-queued on a group without PR #20593 (`ba4648dadf`).
- **What happens next:** PR #20593 is out of the queue. Its dev is reproducing the failure on a merge of `main` and root-causing the gate-versus-restore order. PR #20593 re-enters the queue only when `protocol.metadata-redaction.test.ts` passes on its new head. This anchor can close when that lands; no re-run or quarantine is owed.
